_note: Draft English rendering of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Bamidbar 33, generated by scripts/translate_tafsir_english.py against the JA (not the biblical Hebrew). Translation goal: reverse-translatability for the Tafsir reader — readers should be able to map English back to JA. Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: And these are the stages of the sons of Israel when they went out from the land of Egypt, according to their hosts, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
translations.2: And Moses wrote down their going out, stage by stage, at the word of God. And these are their stages of their going out.
translations.3: And they set out from Ein Shams (Raamses) in the first month, on the fifteenth day — that being the day after the Passover. The sons of Israel went out with a raised hand, in the presence of all the Egyptians,
translations.4: while they were burying those whom God had slain among them — every firstborn — and He had executed judgments upon their deities.
translations.5: And the sons of Israel set out from Ein Shams and encamped at Sukkoth.
translations.6: And they set out from Sukkoth and encamped at Etham, at the edge of the wilderness.
translations.7: And they set out from Etham and turned back to the mouth of the Hiroth, which is before Baal-Zephon, and they encamped before Migdol.
translations.8: And they set out from the mouth of the Hiroth and crossed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness; then they traveled a distance of three days in the wilderness of Etham, and encamped at the Bitterness.
translations.9: And they set out from the Bitterness and came to Elim — and in it were twelve springs of water and seventy palm-trees — and they encamped there.
translations.10: And they set out from Elim and encamped by the Sea of Qulzum (Red Sea).
translations.11: And they set out from the Sea of Qulzum and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
translations.12: And they set out from the wilderness of Sin and encamped at Dophkah.
translations.13: And they set out from Dophkah and encamped at Alush.
translations.14: And they set out from Alush and encamped at Rephidim; and there was no water there for the people to drink.
translations.15: And they set out from Rephidim and encamped in the wilderness of Sinai.
translations.16: And they set out from the wilderness of Sinai and encamped at the Graves of the Desirous.
translations.17: And they set out from the Graves of the Desirous and encamped at Hazeroth.
translations.18: And they set out from Hazeroth and encamped at Rithmah.
translations.19: And they set out from Rithmah and encamped at Rimmon-Perez.
translations.20: And they set out from Rimmon-Perez and encamped at Libnah.
translations.21: And they set out from Libnah and encamped at Rissah.
translations.22: And they set out from Rissah and encamped at Kehelath.
translations.23: And they set out from Kehelath and encamped at Mount Shepher.
translations.24: And they set out from Mount Shepher and encamped at Haradah.
translations.25: And they set out from Haradah and encamped at Makheloth.
translations.26: And they set out from Makheloth and encamped at Tahath.
translations.27: And they set out from Tahath and encamped at Terah.
translations.28: And they set out from Terah and encamped at Mithkah.
translations.29: And they set out from Mithkah and encamped at Hashmonah.
translations.30: And they set out from Hashmonah and encamped at Moseroth.
translations.31: And they set out from Moseroth and encamped at Bene-Yaakan.
translations.32: And they set out from Bene-Yaakan and encamped at Hor-Haggidgad.
translations.33: And they set out from Hor-Haggidgad and encamped at Yotbathah.
translations.34: And they set out from Yotbathah and encamped at Abronah.
translations.35: And they set out from Abronah and encamped at Ezion-Gaber.
translations.36: And they set out from Ezion-Gaber and encamped in the wilderness of Zin — that is Reqem.
translations.37: And they set out from Reqem and encamped at Mount Hor, at the edge of the land of Edom.
translations.38: And Aaron the imām ascended to Mount Hor, and died there at the command of God, in the fortieth year of the going out of the sons of Israel from the land of Egypt, on the first day of the fifth month.
translations.39: And Aaron was a hundred and twenty-three years old when he died there.
translations.40: Then the Canaanite, the king of Arad — who was dwelling in the south in the land of Canaan — heard of the coming of the sons of Israel.
translations.41: Then they set out from Mount Hor and encamped at Zalmonah.
translations.42: And they set out from Zalmonah and encamped at Punon.
translations.43: And they set out from Punon and encamped at Oboth.
translations.44: And they set out from Oboth and encamped at Iye ha-Maʿaz, on the border of Moab.
translations.45: And they set out from Iye ha-Maʿaz and encamped at Dibon-Gad.
translations.46: And they set out from Dibon-Gad and encamped at Almon-Diblathaimah.
translations.47: And they set out from Almon-Diblathaimah and encamped at the mountains of the Hebrews, before Nebo.
translations.48: And they set out from the mountains of the Hebrews and encamped in the open country of Moab, by the Jordan of Jericho.
translations.49: And they encamped by the Jordan, from Beth-Jeshimoth to the meadow of the Acacias — that being in the open country of Moab.
translations.50: And God spoke to Moses in the open country of Moab, by the Jordan of Jericho, with full speech.
translations.51: Command the sons of Israel and say to them: You are crossing the Jordan into the land of Canaan.
translations.52: And drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their ornaments and their graven idols; and their temples of worship you shall demolish.
translations.53: And when you have driven them out, settle the land — for I have given it to you that you may possess it.
translations.54: And you shall apportion it by equal shares among your clans: for the numerous enlarge his portion, and for the few reduce it. To whomever his share falls, in whatever place it may be, that shall be his; according to the tribes of your fathers you shall apportion it.
translations.55: But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then whatever you leave of them shall become like fine needles in your eyes and like thick thorns in your sides, and they shall press hard upon you in the land in which you are settled.
translations.56: And it shall be: just as I intended to do to them, so shall I do to you.
